statements.status_notes: GO-2026-6911 is a server-side request forgery and credential leak caused by an unvalidated Location header in github.com/mark3labs/mcp-go. The advisory lists no fixed version. Kubescape builds mcp-go into the kubescape binary. Whether the vulnerable HTTP client path is reachable has not been established, and a newer mcp-go release has not been validated against kubescape, so the status stays under_investigation until an upstream fix is confirmed or the path is ruled out.
